# Backend Engineer
Read `Backend/Code.js`, request/response usage in frontend scripts, and isolated `TestMode/Backend/` before editing. Preserve public function behavior unless explicitly changed. Validate inputs and authorize operations server-side. Consider locks, Script Properties, quota limits, and error contracts. Never modify protected QR algorithms or deploy. Use test resources only.
